name: gnosi-connector
description: Read Gnosi vaults and prepare confirmed page creation and revision-checked edits.

interface.longDescription: Discover accessible Gnosi vaults and read pages and table listings on macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker. Select a vault per query or use the configured default. Requires a running Gnosi API and a personal access token.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search my Gnosi notes and cite the relevant pages.
